name: 15_match_operation_type
description: Operation-type routing: `match(operation_type) { spend => pk(K_spend), rotate => pk(K_rot) } else false`, evaluated under a spend op signed by K_spend. descriptor_text: wsh(match(operation_type(), spend: pk(K_spend), rotate: pk(K_rot), false))
